questions.question: How did Sukuna survive after his death?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: Before his death, Sukuna was helped by Kenjaku to live on after death by splitting his soul into twenty cursed objects created from his fingers.

questions.question: Why did Yuji eat Sukuna's finger?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji eats the finger in order to fight off the cursed spirits

questions.question: What deal did Sukuna offer Yuji after he died?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna proposes to bring Yuji back to life, with the condition that he will be able to take complete control of his body for a minute, but also swearing he won't harm any of his friends when he does.

questions.question: How did Sukuna respond when Mahito touched his soul again?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna senses that Mahito has touched his soul again and brutally wounds him for attempting to mess with him.

questions.question: What did Mahito collect from the Tokyo college during the Goodwill Event?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: The fingers that are at the Tokyo college are collected, along with the Death Painting Wombs 1-3, by Mahito.

questions.question: How did Sukuna eat his finger back after Megumi retrieved it?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna creates a mouth on Yuji's palm and eats the finger when Megumi gives it to Yuji.

questions.question: What deal did Sukuna make with Jogo?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna then makes a deal with Jogo: if he can land a hit on him then he will kill everyone in Shibuya (minus one), which Jogo agrees to.

questions.question: Why did Sukuna heal Megumi during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna heals Megumi and tells him to not die yet since there is something that he needs Megumi to do still.

questions.question: Why did Sukuna choose Megumi as his new vessel?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna waited until Megumi's will was crushed in order to ensure he was a controllable vessel rather than a cage like Yuji.

questions.question: Why didn't Sukuna use his Shrine technique against Yorozu?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna is intent on only using the Ten Shadows Technique because he wants to figuratively stain Megumi's hands with the blood of his sister.

questions.question: How did Sukuna kill Gojo?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna's world-cutting slash bisected Gojo horizontally, completely severing the top half of his body. Satoru Gojo is killed and Sukuna is victorious in the battle of the strongest.

questions.question: How did the reign of Ryomen Sukuna end?
questions.subject: Sukuna/Synopsis

answer.item: As he uttered those final words, his form disintegrated into dust; bringing an end to the reign of Ryomen Sukuna, the King of Curses once and for all.
